title: Coconut Chutney
description: A smooth, mildly spiced chutney ground from fresh coconut and roasted gram, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves — the standard side for idli and dosa.
steps: In a blender, combine the grated coconut, roasted chana dal, green chillies, ginger and salt.
Add water a little at a time and blend to a smooth, thick chutney — it should be pourable but not watery.
For the tempering, heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the urad dal, frying until golden.
Add the dried red chilli and curry leaves, letting them sizzle for 20-30 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the chutney and mix in lightly. Serve fresh alongside idli, dosa or vada.
